newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms as interest rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms as interest rates rise.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar firmed to 469.50/470.75 as yields on benchmark Central Bank TEMs firmed across the curve contrary to expectations, traders said.
The unit closed on Tuesday at 470.75/471.75 bolivars per dollar.

"There were strong interbank (dollar) sell orders as soon as the results of the TEM auction came through," said one trader. Yields on six month TEMS rose 36 basis points to 21.98 percent, while yields on one year paper rose 194 baisis points to 27.73 percent.
Traders said the Central Bank did not participate in the day's session.
